The `Accept` header sets the return format: `application/json` returns an array of JSON documents with the key ID and a serialized public key with `

data.description_suggestion: Retrieves all currently valid PEM-formatted public keys that can be used to verify Portal Framework JWTs. This endpoint is typically used to obtain the complete set of active signing keys for JWT validation. Unexpired tokens may have been signed with any of these keys, particularly during key rotation periods. The `Accept` header controls the response format: `application/json` returns an array of JSON documents, each containing a key ID and serialized public key (with `\n` instead of newlines), while `text/plain` or `application/x-x509-ca-cert` returns a concatenated list of public keys as plain text with valid newline characters. Use this endpoint to build or refresh your local key cache for JWT verification.

The `Accept` header sets the return format: `application/json` returns an array of JSON documents with the key ID and a serialized public key with `
